title: Melee Decomp Reference: Common Movement Path
description: Left-side reference graph from standstill using explicit Melee common fighter state names from ftCommon. This is the movement/control path, not every damage, throw, item, ledge, or character-special state.

nodes.label: EntryEnd
nodes.notes: EntryEnd uses x6C0, optionally calls ftColl_8007B760 with x6C8, then enters normal airborne/fall handling.

nodes.label: EntryStart
nodes.notes: EntryStart uses x6BC, x6C4, and accessory/platform interpolation before calling ftCo_800C6B6C.

nodes.label: Entry
nodes.notes: ftCo_MS_Entry waits on Player_GetUnk4C, hides the fighter, records base Y, then transitions into EntryStart.

nodes.label: WalkSlow
nodes.notes: Low walk bucket selected from current gr_vel; Walk_Anim rate uses gr_vel or mv.co.walk.x0.

nodes.label: WalkMiddle
nodes.notes: Middle walk bucket selected from current gr_vel; bucket remap preserves animation phase.

nodes.label: WalkFast
nodes.notes: Fast walk bucket below dash/run threshold; Walk_Phys stores mv.co.walk.x0 = target_vel * x440.

nodes.label: Turn
nodes.notes: Standing/smash turn spine. Turn IASA temporarily flips facing for early action checks, replays x1C latched A/B on the just-turned frame, arms dash-out through fn_800C9C2C, and can be entered by an earlier state input callback before same-frame Turn_Phys.
physics: Fighter_Spaghetti_8006AD10 runs the current input_cb before Fighter_procUpdate runs phys_cb.
ftCo_Turn_IASA flips facing_dir before source action helpers when has_turned is false, then restores it before guard/jump/dash checks.
On the just-turned frame, input.x668 is ORed with mv.co.turn.x1C so latched A/B can be replayed through the normal source action priority.
Fighter_ChangeMotionState updates phys_cb immediately, so a state that enters Turn during IASA receives Turn_Phys later in that same engine frame.
ftCo_Turn_Phys calls ft_80084F3C: gr_friction is doubled by common x6C when ABS(gr_vel) exceeds walk_max_vel, then staged as xE4_ground_accel_1.

nodes.label: Dash
nodes.notes: Initial dash. Dash dance and moonwalk behavior emerges from this state plus input timing, grounded gr_vel staging, run handoff, and non-run completion back to Wait. Dash entry uses the source xE8_ground_accel_2 path, while ordinary Dash/Run/friction acceleration uses xE4_ground_accel_1.
physics: ftCo_Dash_Enter computes init_vel = facing_dir * dash_initial_velocity.
If gr_vel already points opposite the new facing, mv.co.dash.x0 is set to init_vel; otherwise it is set to init_vel - gr_vel.
ftCommon_800804A0 stages mv.co.dash.x0 into xE8_ground_accel_2, applying floor friction multiplier when below 1.0.
ftCo_Dash_Phys consumes mv.co.dash.x0 on the entry physics tick by clearing it; ordinary Dash acceleration does not run until later Dash physics ticks.
After the entry tick, ftCo_Dash_Phys calls getAccelAndTarget and ftCommon_8007C98C, which stages live-stick Dash/Run acceleration or friction into xE4_ground_accel_1.
ftCommon_ApplyGroundMovement converts gr_vel and xE4_ground_accel_1 into self_vel and anim_vel along the floor normal; xE8_ground_accel_2 is not part of same-frame translation.
Fighter_procUpdate commits gr_vel += xE4_ground_accel_1 + xE8_ground_accel_2, then clears both acceleration slots.

nodes.label: Squat
nodes.notes: Crouch entry. Can arm platform pass through ftCo_80099F9C and the Squat IASA countdown route.

nodes.label: Pass
nodes.notes: Common drop-through platform state 244. The shared pass gate checks down input, y-tap timing, and platform support; shield-held pass enters immediately while Squat can arm a delayed countdown. ftCo_Pass_Anim exits to Fall when the Pass animation has no frames remaining.

nodes.label: KneeBend
nodes.notes: Jump squat. Grounded IASA can enter KneeBend before the same frame's Phys callback, so ftCo_KneeBend_Phys/ft_80084F3C applies grounded friction and writes self_vel/x74_anim_vel through ftCommon_ApplyGroundMovement. On animation completion, ftCo_KneeBend_Anim enters JumpF/JumpB before Phys, so ftCo_Jump_Enter scales the previous grounded self_vel by ground_to_air_jump_momentum_multiplier without a fresh takeoff-frame KneeBend friction tick.

nodes.label: Run
nodes.notes: Sustained run after initial dash. Run_Anim decrements mv.co.run.x0 before Run_IASA tests the TurnRun no-interrupt boundary.

nodes.label: RunDirect
nodes.notes: RunDirect is a common motion-state table identity that reuses Run submotion/physics callbacks but has its own IASA callback. Local decomp search shows callbacks and table registration, but no normal Fighter_ChangeMotionState entry site.

nodes.label: RunBrake
nodes.notes: Explicit run braking state. RunBrake_Enter clears cmd vars, seeds max_run_brake_frames, RunBrake_Anim handles command-var animation pause around PlCo x42C and countdown fallback, RunBrake_IASA checks jump, cmd_vars[0] && fn_800C9CEC TurnRun, then squat, and RunBrake_Phys applies gr_friction * x60.

nodes.label: TurnRun
nodes.notes: Run turnaround entered through PlCo x38 with old-facing accel_mul persistence. TurnRun_Anim uses cmd_vars[1] to pause at the action-script gate until velocity crosses, then completion calls fn_800CA644 to enter Run or fallback.

nodes.label: GuardSetOff
nodes.notes: Shield hitstun/setoff state when shield absorbs a hit.

nodes.label: EscapeAir
nodes.notes: Airdodge movement state. Action state 44 maps to PlyCaptain5K_Share_ACTION_EscapeAir_figatree in PlCaAJ.dat with a 50-frame FigaTree duration; ECB source points come from ftDataCaptain.x44, the Captain costume HSD joint preorder, sampled FigaTree tracks, and mpColl_LoadECB_JObj reduction.

nodes.label: FallSpecial
nodes.notes: Special fall after airdodge or special fall action. Action state 26 maps to PlyCaptain5K_Share_ACTION_FallSpecial_figatree in PlCaAJ.dat.

nodes.label: LandingFallSpecial
nodes.notes: Landing lag from EscapeAir/FallSpecial; EscapeAir landing lag comes from common-data x344. ftCo_LandingFallSpecial_Enter calls shared Landing entry with anim_speed = (0.1 + fp->x2EC) / landing_lag, where x2EC is Falcon's cached Landing animation duration.

nodes.label: SpecialSStart
nodes.notes: Captain grounded side-B start state. ftCo_SpecialS_CheckInput dispatches to ftCa_SpecialS_Enter, which changes to ftCa_MS_SpecialSStart; action-table slot 303 maps to PlyCaptain5K_Share_ACTION_SpecialSStart_figatree.

nodes.label: SpecialS
nodes.notes: Captain grounded side-B hit state entered by ftCa_SpecialS_OnDetect from SpecialSStart; action-table slot 304 maps to PlyCaptain5K_Share_ACTION_SpecialS_figatree.

nodes.label: SpecialAirSStart
nodes.notes: Captain aerial side-B start state. ftCo_SpecialAir_CheckInput dispatches to ftCa_SpecialAirS_Enter, which changes to ftCa_MS_SpecialAirSStart; action-table slot 305 maps to PlyCaptain5K_Share_ACTION_SpecialAirSStart_figatree.

nodes.label: SpecialAirS
nodes.notes: Captain aerial side-B hit state entered by ftCa_SpecialS_OnDetect from SpecialAirSStart; action-table slot 306 maps to PlyCaptain5K_Share_ACTION_SpecialAirS_figatree.

edges.label: x6C0 countdown expires
edges.notes: Rust exits to Fall on the x6C0 schedule; the optional x6C8 collision handoff is recorded as a remaining gap.

edges.label: x6BC countdown expires
edges.notes: EntryStart_Anim decrements x6BC and calls ftCo_800C6B6C when it reaches zero.

edges.label: timer reaches zero
edges.notes: Entry_Anim checks timer 0, enters EntryStart, then decrements the newly seeded x6BC timer on the same source frame.

Dash entry stages xE8_ground_accel_2 through ftCommon_800804A0.

edges.notes: Walk carry remains in gr_vel; Dash entry adds the source initial-dash delta through xE8 rather than clearing movement first.
physics: Walk exit does not clear gr_vel.
Dash entry computes the xE8 delta from current gr_vel and facing_dir.
This preserved walk carry is a required moonwalk setup input to the Dash velocity lifecycle.

edges.input: fresh opposite X tap / smash turn
edges.notes: Walk IASA can enter Turn through ftCo_Dash_CheckInput; the later same-frame Fighter_procUpdate uses the new Turn phys_cb, so carried walk gr_vel receives ft_80084F3C friction before the follow-up dash-out.
physics: Walk carry remains in gr_vel when ftCo_Dash_CheckInput routes opposite fresh dash input into ftCo_Turn_Enter_Smash.
The same frame uses Turn_Phys/ft_80084F3C, staging gr_friction into xE4 before gr_vel is committed.
The next Turn dash-out frame calls ftCo_Dash_Enter and stages the initial dash delta through xE8.

edges.input: Dash cmd_vars[0] script gate is set while run-zone stick is held
edges.frames: Falcon Dash action script sets cmd_vars[0] at frame 16
edges.notes: ftCo_Dash_IASA can enter Run through fn_800CA5F0 only after the Dash action script has set cmd_vars[0]. Because Fighter_procUpdate runs after input_cb, the new Run phys_cb can apply Run_Phys on that same frame. This is separate from Dash_Anim's non-run completion fallback.

edges.input: dash animation completes without same-facing run handoff
edges.frames: Falcon Dash figatree completion at frame 29 when cmd-var Run handoff does not occur
edges.notes: Melee Dash animation completion returns to Wait with carried gr_vel; any held walk/opposite intent is handled by the next Wait IASA priority pass.

edges.input: opposite fresh dash/smash-turn input during initial dash
edges.notes: Opposite fresh dash input routes through ftCo_Dash_CheckInput into ftCo_Turn_Enter_Smash; because the input callback runs before Fighter_procUpdate, the same frame then uses Turn_Phys rather than Dash_Phys. The next dash is produced by the Turn dash-out path rather than a separate dash-dance state.
physics: ftCo_Dash_IASA checks the opposite-stick dashback branch only after the tap-start early Dash branch is no longer active.
When ftCo_Dash_CheckInput succeeds, ftCo_Dash_IASA still falls through to the x54 gr_vel decay block before the frame's physics/commit path continues.
Fighter_ChangeMotionState swaps phys_cb during IASA; Fighter_procUpdate then calls Turn_Phys/ft_80084F3C in the same frame before gr_vel is committed.
A successful opposite fresh dash enters Turn; Turn later calls ftCo_Dash_Enter, which stages the next dash delta through the same xE8 path.
Any apparent dash dance pivot comes from Dash, Turn, ftCo_Dash_Enter, and the shared gr_vel commit order.
